subject: oriental hornet
title: Oriental Hornets Drink 80 Percent Alcohol and Don't Get Drunk

scenes.text: This hornet drinks liquor stronger than vodka. Nothing happens.
Scientists fed oriental hornets sugar water spiked with alcohol, up to eighty percent.
That's twice as strong as vodka. Honeybees on the same diet died within a day.
The hornets kept drinking for weeks, behaved normally, and lived just as long.
Why? Their bodies break the alcohol down so fast it never builds up.
They feed on fermenting fruit. Eighty percent alcohol, and not even a buzz.

description:
In a 2024 PNAS study, Oriental hornets drank sugar solutions with up to 80% ethanol for weeks with no change in behaviour or lifespan, while honeybees on the same diet died within 24 hours.
The hornets metabolize ethanol very efficiently; most vertebrates suffer above about 4%.
Which animal do you think holds its drink worst?
first_comment: Hornets that looked knocked out recovered fully within a few minutes. What drink would wipe you out first?
